title: Official Branch Launch on 4 November
author: Branch Executive Committee
summary: The IEEE Student Branch at Cavendish University Uganda will hold its Official Branch Launch on Wednesday 4 November 2026 at Cavendish University Uganda.
content:
Mark your calendar: the Official Branch Launch takes place on Wednesday 4 November 2026 at Cavendish University Uganda.

The launch follows IEEE Day on 6 October 2026, when the branch joined student branches from across Uganda at the American Center in Kabalagala and received its official certificate of approval.

The time, the exact location on campus and the programme will be announced soon. The launch page will update as soon as details are confirmed, and you can add the date to your calendar from there: /events/branch-launch-2026
